title: Road Blockades in Southern Peru Cut Off Major Silver-Copper Mine
content: Anti-government protests in southern Peru have escalated into road blockades that have cut off supply routes to one of the country's largest silver-copper mining complexes, forcing the operator to suspend concentrate shipments. Peru is the world's second-largest silver-producing country, and prolonged blockades in prior years have led to multi-week production halts. The government has not yet said how it plans to respond.
